name: Little Green Light
description: Little Green Light is a nonprofit donor-management and fundraising CRM for constituents, gifts, appeals, campaigns, memberships, events, volunteering and relationship history.
agentUseSummary: Add an administrator-generated Little Green Light API key, choose which agents may use the connection, and run all 141 operations in the official dynamic REST contract through pinned routes. Safe mode runs 68 reads directly and requires approval for 73 mutations.

credentialRequirements.label: Little Green Light API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: An administrator generates the API key under Settings, Integration settings, LGL API. Relay encrypts it and sends it only to api.littlegreenlight.com in the Bearer authorization header.

allowed.label: Read Little Green Light
allowed.description: Use every documented read in Little Green Light's public REST API.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Little Green Light
approvalRequired.description: Create, update or delete authorized nonprofit CRM records; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 68 reads run directly; all 73 mutations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 141 documented REST operations run without Relay per-action approval; fixed routes, audits, bounds, provider permissions and limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts all 141 documented Little Green Light REST operations with a fixed origin and server-side Bearer authentication.
Relay mounts all 141 documented Little Green Light REST operations with a fixed origin and server-side Bearer authentication.

providerSetup.blocker: Live acceptance requires an authorized Little Green Light account with API access enabled, an administrator-generated API key and representative nonprofit records; this code-only worker has none of them.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized administrator requests API access if necessary, generates a dedicated API key under Settings, Integration settings, LGL API, stores it through Relay Console, and validates representative reads and approved reversible mutations, key replacement, key deletion, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in Railway staging.

evidence.supports: Little Green Light documents a read/write developer API, account-level enablement, API terms and a limit of 300 calls per five-minute period.
The official REST documentation and its linked dynamic Swagger contract document API-key Basic, query-token or Bearer authentication and 141 current v1 operations; Relay uses the non-URL Bearer form.
Little Green Light publishes API-specific terms governing customer-authorized use of its developer interface.
